Snakes & Ladders: Kurukshetra

Every roll is a battle for Moksha.

Snakes and ladders, reimagined on the battlefield of Kurukshetra.

Choose a Pandava warrior, race across an ancient board of divine ladders and Naga serpents, and reach square 100 first. Each warrior carries one ability, and three snake bites recharge it, so the board rewards a well-timed decision as well as a lucky roll.

ArjunaArcher's Precision: move one square fewer to dodge a snake or reach a ladder.
YudhishthiraDharma's Second Throw: landing on a snake? Throw again.
SahadevaForesight: see the trap coming and stay where you are.
BhimaIron Body: slide only half a snake's length.
NakulaSwift Recovery: take the snake, but your next roll moves two extra squares.
  • Online battles against real players, with dice rolled on the server for fair play
  • Local Quest: pass and play for up to 5 players on one phone
  • Realistic 3D dice and animated ladders, snakes and powers
  • Warrior abilities recharge after three snake bites
  • Face the Asura, a Naga Master the first snake won't bite
  • Earn Karma online and unlock legendary warriors
  • Google Play Games sign-in, achievements and leaderboards
  • My Journey: your battle history and stats

OneBreath: Breathing Exercises

A calmer mind starts with one breath.

Guided breathing exercises with a living Bodhi tree.

Hold the screen and breathe in to gather light from a living galaxy. Hold your breath, then let go: the energy flows into a seed and grows a Bodhi tree, exactly as much as you breathed. A full cycle takes under a minute.

Gentle4 · 4 · 6
Relaxing4 · 7 · 8
Deepen6 · 12 · 12
Yogi4 · 16 · 8
InhaleHoldExhaleSeconds
  • A countdown for every inhale, hold and exhale
  • Hold past your target and the timer turns gold
  • Leaves, blossoms and fruit as your tree matures
  • Tap the tree to shed leaves on the breeze
  • Ambient sound, a Tibetan bell and soft haptics
  • Parallax depth that moves with your phone
  • Trees, days, streaks and session history
  • 15 achievements and a reduced motion option

ParkTrace: Find Parking & Car

Never lose your car again.

Find parking. Save your spot. Get back in seconds.

Save your spot in one tap, add the floor, pillar and a photo, then follow live guidance until the app says you’re there. Underground, where GPS is weak, your photo, pillar and notes take over. Need a space first? Find parking shows the nearest car parks on a map, with opening hours, phone and directions.

  • Find parking on a map, with filters
  • One-tap save
  • Floor, pillar, zone, row and notes
  • Parking photo
  • Live guidance back to your car
  • Can’t find it: photo, notes and past visits
  • Reminders and parking history
  • Home-screen widget

PartPay UPI: Split & Pay

Split the amount. Keep the payment yours.

Plan and track big payments, one part at a time.

Enter the total amount. PartPay splits it into smaller parts of up to ₹1,999 each. For each part, PartPay copies the amount and opens your UPI app. You choose the person, enter your UPI PIN and pay in your UPI app. Then come back to PartPay and mark the result.

  • Splits the amount into parts of up to ₹1,999
  • Pay one part at a time, in order
  • Copies the amount and opens your UPI app
  • Mark the result of each part yourself
  • Save the 12-digit UTR if you like
  • Continue an unfinished split anytime
  • Remembers your last-used UPI app
  • Light, dark or system theme
  • Split totals up to ₹1,00,000
  • Watch one short ad for 12 hours ad-free
Free with adsSplits stay on your phoneWorks offlineMade for India

Your UPI PIN and bank details stay in your UPI app. You confirm each payment yourself, and your UPI app’s history is the final record of every payment.

Less noise. More intent.

Each SS Pixels product can be different in purpose, but the product principles stay consistent.

  • Collect less by default.

    Use local storage where it makes sense and only request access when the feature actually needs it.

  • Make the main action obvious.

    A good mobile interface should explain itself before the user needs a tutorial.

  • Use platform-native strengths.

    Modern Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, Play services and system APIs where they improve the experience.

  • Price clearly. No traps.

    One-time purchases with clear prices, and free games kept free with ads rather than paywalls.
